title: Assignment 4 - Cantilever Beam Stress and Deflection

sections.heading: Given
sections.body: Point load P = 500 N applied at the free end. Span L = 2.0 m. Rectangular section width b = 0.05 m and height h = 0.10 m. Young's modulus E = 200 GPa. The beam is treated as linear elastic and prismatic, and self weight is neglected.

sections.heading: Maximum bending stress
sections.body: The maximum bending moment occurs at the fixed support: M = P * L = 500 N * 2.0 m = 1000 N*m. The rectangular section modulus is S = b * h^2 / 6 = 0.05 m * (0.10 m)^2 / 6 = 8.3333e-5 m^3. The maximum bending stress is sigma = M / S = 1000 N*m / 8.3333e-5 m^3 = 1.2000e7 Pa, which is 12.0 MPa.

sections.heading: Maximum free-end deflection
sections.body: The second moment of area is I = b * h^3 / 12 = 0.05 m * (0.10 m)^3 / 12 = 4.1667e-6 m^4. The free-end deflection of a cantilever under an end point load is delta = P * L^3 / (3 * E * I) = 500 N * (2.0 m)^3 / (3 * 200e9 Pa * 4.1667e-6 m^4) = 1.6000e-3 m, which is 1.60 mm.
